comparison.objective: Load four flat blanks into a tight gravity magazine; candidate depins one terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated squaring, low-clearance planar insertion and controlled release versus recessed blade insertion, latch release and coupled pulling.
comparison.success_condition: All four blanks lie flat and stacked in the magazine; candidate requires selected terminal out and all other connector elements intact. Candidate numeric limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Shared insertion is only a generic primitive; the tested end state and mechanics differ.
